items.exampleEn: It was thoughtless of me to forget your birthday.
items.exampleZh: 我忘了你的生日，真是太不體貼了。

items.exampleEn: The report overemphasizes small problems and ignores big ones.
items.exampleZh: 那份報告過分強調小問題，卻忽略了大問題。

items.exampleEn: She mentioned offhand that she was leaving the company.
items.exampleZh: 她隨口提到她要離開公司了。

items.exampleEn: Don't prejudge a book by its first page.
items.exampleZh: 別只看第一頁就評斷一本書。

items.exampleEn: Her new book is funny and very quotable.
items.exampleZh: 她的新書很好笑，而且有很多值得引用的句子。

items.exampleEn: Our old dog is mistrustful of strangers at first.
items.exampleZh: 我們家的老狗一開始對陌生人不太信任。

items.exampleEn: Try to see the problem from my point of view.
items.exampleZh: 試著從我的角度來看這個問題。

items.exampleEn: Which of these two dictionaries is more recommendable for students?
items.exampleZh: 這兩本字典哪一本比較值得推薦給學生？

items.sentenceEn: A thoughtless comment can hurt someone for years.
items.sentenceZh: 一句欠考慮的話，可能會讓人難過好幾年。

items.audioEn: The science museum downtown is highly recommended if you have young kids.
items.audioZh: 如果你家有小小孩，市中心那間科學博物館很值得推薦。
items.questionZh: 說話者覺得那間博物館怎麼樣？
options: It's a great place for families

items.sentenceEn: From a child's point of view, the trip was far too long.
items.sentenceZh: 從孩子的角度來看，那趟旅程實在太長了。

items.sentenceEn: After losing money online, she became mistrustful of emails asking for help.
items.sentenceZh: 她在網路上被騙錢之後，就不再相信那些請求幫忙的電子郵件了。

items.stemEn: The speech was short but very ____; newspapers printed many of its lines.
items.stemZh: 那場演講很短，但很有金句，報紙引用了其中很多句子。

items.stemEn: The judges promised not to ____ any dancer before the dance was over.
items.stemZh: 評審答應在舞跳完之前不先評斷任何一位舞者。

items.passageEn: Last month, I interviewed a well-known local chef for our school newspaper. I was nervous because some people say she can be thoughtless with young reporters, but I tried not to prejudge her. She was friendly and very quotable: "Good food is just honest food," she said. When I asked how many dishes were on her menu, she said she couldn't tell me offhand. She told me that cooking shows overemphasize fancy tools, and that, from her point of view, a sharp knife is all you need. She also gave me some of her exquisite little cakes and told me which cheap places in town were recommendable. Even my friend Kai, who is mistrustful of famous people, wanted to read the interview.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我為校刊採訪了一位本地知名的主廚。我很緊張，因為有人說她對年輕記者有時不太體貼，但我盡量不先對她下定論。結果她很友善，說的話也很值得引用：「好的食物就是誠實的食物。」她說。我問她菜單上有幾道菜，她說一時說不上來。她告訴我，烹飪節目太過強調高級廚具，從她的角度來看，一把鋒利的刀就夠了。她還送我幾個她做的精緻小蛋糕，並告訴我鎮上哪些便宜的小店值得推薦。就連不太信任名人的朋友 Kai，也想讀這篇訪問。

questions.questionZh: 作者採訪前為什麼很緊張？
options: 作者從來沒採訪過別人
聽說她對年輕記者不太體貼

questions.questionZh: 主廚認為做菜最需要什麼？
options: 最新鮮昂貴的進口食材

items.promptZh: 老師說我們不應該過分強調分數。
referenceEn: The teacher said that we shouldn't overemphasize grades.
Our teacher told us not to overemphasize scores.
rubricZh: overemphasize 的用法，例如 overemphasize grades、overemphasize scores 等
時態合理（例如 said、told 等）

items.promptZh: 這家旅館乾淨又便宜，非常值得推薦。
referenceEn: This hotel is clean and cheap, so it is very recommendable.
Clean and cheap, this hotel is very recommendable.
rubricZh: recommendable 可放 be 動詞後或名詞前（例如 is very recommendable、a recommendable hotel 等）
